gloss_en: The remembrance/retention of the Torah — that the Torah not be forgotten from Israel (זִכְרִירַת/זְכִירַת הַתּוֹרָה, as in R. Shimon bar Yochai's promise 'לֹא תִּשְׁתַּכַּח תּוֹרָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל'), i.e., the enduring preservation of Torah knowledge in the Jewish people; not memory in general nor any other homograph
